title: Screen Candidate Application in Payroll
description: Complete the screen candidate application workflow in the Payroll module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with admin access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Payroll module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for screen candidate application are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Payroll module from the main navigation.
Locate the screen candidate application entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for screen candidate application.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Screen Candidate Application completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Payroll views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during screen candidate application.
Permission constraints prevent completion of screen candidate application.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun screen candidate application.
Confirm role permissions for admin and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun screen candidate application?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm screen candidate application is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
